findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_step, get_play, search_plays, define_term, get_directory · Private data: search_knowledge, record_outcome · Public sink: join_waitlist, search_plays, do_marketing, get_directory · Destructive: do_marketing, record_outcome.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_step, get_play, search_plays, define_term, get_directory · Private data: search_knowledge, record_outcome · Public sink: join_waitlist, search_plays, do_marketing, get_directory · Destructive: do_marketing, record_outcome

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
